Composition & Indication

Levofloxacin 500mg — 7 Tablets (Generic for Levaquin®) contains Levofloxacin Hemihydrate 500 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 7 Tablets at the official 500mg strength. The standard indication is the management of bacterial infections (urinary tract, respiratory), per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Levofloxacin 500mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.
